name: nondro
description: Your organization's governed data and knowledge, through its own nondro workspace.

interface.longDescription:
nondro connects ChatGPT to your organization's governed data and knowledge, through your organization's own nondro workspace.

Ask about the business objects your organization defines (customers, shipments, cases, whatever they are), query its data where it lives, read its documents and shared knowledge, and continue work that you or your colleagues shared in nondro. Every answer respects your permissions in the workspace: ChatGPT sees only what you may see.

nondro can also draft. New object types, mappings and knowledge notes are created as drafts, and nothing becomes live until a person with the right permission promotes it in nondro. Write-backs to your organization's systems through its actions are proposed for a person to decide.

To connect, give your work email: nondro finds your organization, and you sign in at its workspace, choosing what ChatGPT may do and for how long. nondro is for organizations that use a nondro workspace; your administrator can tell you whether yours does.
defaultPrompt: What business objects and data does my organization have in nondro?
What does my organization know about our main suppliers?
Show me the open work in nondro that I can pick up.

positive.description: Reads the organization's catalog of business objects.
positive.prompt: What kinds of business objects does Andes Freight have in nondro?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the organization's object types from its catalog, shipments among them, without inventing any.

positive.description: Queries the organization's warehouse in place, read-only.
positive.prompt: How many Andes Freight shipments were delivered after their promised date?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 130, from a read-only query over the organization's warehouse, and says where the figure came from.

positive.description: Filters the organization's objects by state.
positive.prompt: Which Andes Freight shipments are in transit right now, and with which carriers?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists shipments whose status is in transit, each with its carrier (for example TransCaribe Carga), from the organization's objects.

positive.description: Searches the organization's catalog and opens a result.
positive.prompt: Search nondro for shipments and open the most relevant result.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching definitions from the organization's catalog (the Shipments dataset and its mapping onto the Shipment object type), then fetches one and summarizes its definition.

positive.description: Drafts a new object type, which stays a draft.
positive.prompt: In nondro, draft a new object type for customer complaints, with a title and a severity.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft object type, or, if a draft with that purpose already exists, points to it instead of making a duplicate; either way it says the type is not live until a person with promotion rights promotes it in nondro, and nothing in the organization's systems changes.

negative.description: General knowledge unrelated to the organization.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Bogotá tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing with no organizational data.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: No tool takes the conversation or the app's memory any more. Handing work off from ChatGPT takes handoff_note, a short summary the AI writes of the work (4,000 characters at most), instead of a transcript; the tool that imported an AI app's memory is not offered. Every connection sees the same tool definitions.
